newsitem.title: THAILAND: One Holding appoints financial adviser.
newsitem.headline: One Holding appoints financial adviser.

text.p: Thailand's One Holding Plc, a producer of construction materials and property developer, said on Thursday it had appointed Dhana Siam Finance and Securities as its financial adviser to restructure its loans.
One Holding said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the company and Dhana Siam were working out a loan restructuring plan, expected to be completed within one month.
The company said negotiations with its creditors would be arranged after a suitable and fair conclusion for all creditors that could be reached.
One Holding, partly owned by Finance One Plc, last week failed to pay $13.5 million owed on bills of exchange due to liquidity problems.
On Monday, the Thai bourse extended further the suspension in trading of One Holding shares at the company's request to March 28.
